title: Notification templates and subscriptions authored in Setup have no effect on the app's notifications
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-20** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin; Notification Templates and Subscriptions.
- **Steps:** templates for topic `urgent_task`, channel `inbox`, locales `en` and `en-US`, and one for `crm.urgent_task` (the `template` key the flow sends), all active; subscription `user:<qa.plain>` on `urgent_task`; create an urgent task (flow `task_urgent_alert`, `src/sales/flows/task-urgent-alert.flow.ts`).
- **Expected:** Templates' empty state: "Add a template per topic, channel and locale; until then, a notification is sent with the title and body its sender provides." Subscriptions: "A subscription records that a role, a team or a user follows a notification topic."
- **Actual:** the inbox title stays "Urgent task: …" for every variant; `qa.plain` receives nothing (0 → 0). The notification's payload is `{"template":"crm.urgent_task","templateData":{…}}`.
- **Evidence:** [`34-config-notification-templates-list.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/34-config-notification-templates-list.png), [`33-config-notification-subscriptions-created.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/33-config-notification-subscriptions-created.png), [`37-diagnostics-notifications-detail.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/37-diagnostics-notifications-detail.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** admins customising notifications. *Verdict PLAUSIBLE for the subscription half*: the flow names explicit recipients, and the platform may route topic subscriptions only for broadcasts.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `service-messaging` (template selection, subscription fan-out); HotCRM `task-urgent-alert.flow.ts` only as the sender used.
- **Dedupe words:** notification template not applied, subscription no delivery, crm.urgent_task.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** no runtime code reads `sys_notification_subscription`. The inbox channel takes templates from `IEmailService.renderTemplate`, not from `sys_notification_template`. So the subscription half holds as a setting with no effect, without the tester's caveat.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 2 hits in objectstack, 0 in objectui, none on point. **New.**
